claims.statement: Dogs Trust Puppy 101 and adolescent life-stage guidance note that dogs can show renewed fear or testing behaviour during adolescence; owners should reduce pressure and keep training positive.
Dogs Trust focus and target-style training rewards the dog for orienting to the handler's hand, building engagement before adding distractions (aligned with focus training batch 006).

protocols.title: Rescue dog — first weeks settling plan
protocols.intendedOutcome: Owner provides predictable routine and low-pressure environment while dog adjusts.
inappropriateWhen: Severe aggression or panic without professional plan

steps.instruction: Keep routine predictable; allow dog to approach people and novelty at their pace; reward calm exploration.
steps.progressCriteria: Dog eats and rests in home within first days.
failureModes: Flooding with too many new experiences

protocols.generalisationMaintenance: Add one new context at a time.
referralRequirements: Dogs Trust Behaviour Support Line or ABTC behaviourist

protocols.title: Adolescent regression — reduce pressure
protocols.intendedOutcome: Owner maintains positive training and management when teenage testing or fear resurfaces.

steps.instruction: Shorten sessions; revisit foundation skills at easier criteria; avoid punishment for 'regression'.
steps.easierIfStruggling: Pause new skills; focus on sleep and enrichment.

lessons.title: Build a stay
lessons.summary: Reward your dog in position, return before treating, and build duration before distance.

lessons.title: Emergency recall practice
lessons.summary: Make coming back always worth it—never punish late returns; use a long line until skills are solid.

lessons.title: Help a rescue dog settle in
lessons.summary: Go slowly, keep routines predictable, and get professional support if fear or aggression persists.

lessons.title: When your teenage dog regresses
lessons.summary: Shorten sessions, revisit easy wins, and stay force-free through adolescent ups and downs.

disagreements.question: Has post-2024 systematic review evidence changed the strength of claims about aversive vs reward training?
areasOfAgreement: Scoping reviews continue to flag training methods as welfare-relevant themes.
disagreements.disagreementSummary: No new pooled meta-analysis ingested in batch 008; monitoring continues.
disagreements.goodDogPosition: Maintain reward-based recommendation; update disagreements when new SR ingested.
